verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe a local-only mode — "local database file, no server needed (recommended)" that "runs entirely in your process" and is fully SQLite-compatible, with no account or token required, ideal for offline dev and CI (turso-docs-2, turso-docs-16, turso-docs-30, turso-docs-54). The embedded engine is also positioned as usable offline/in-browser/on-device (turso-docs-49), and community reports confirm local usage works well (turso-comm-2) though with some SQLite-compatibility edge cases (turso-comm-4, turso-comm-8). missing for 10: independent CI-specific case study, and confirmation there's zero telemetry/account touch in the local-only CLI path.
